similarity.justification: Weighted Jaccard compares sparse count vectors by shared quantities over union quantities, handles different deck sizes/features transparently, and keeps exact zone/version features isolated.

vectors.schema: sparse count vector: feature key = zone|exact cardNumber|source-proven version or NO_VERSION; a version enters identity only when the card carries explicit printing provenance (versionProven===true or versionSource in [printingId, catalogPrinting]) — a published rarity label is not proof and maps to NO_VERSION, with the discarded label kept in unprovenVersionLabels. Quantities preserved; zones and versions are never conflated. Feature indexes are artifact-local: each month artifact is analyzed independently from its own deck subset.
